read.en: Lumentum rose 10.7% on Nov 9 to $596.16, trading $545.01–616.30. It closed above the falling 5-day average ($590.3) but below the falling 10-day ($717.6), 30-day ($871.6) and 100-day ($851.2) and the rising 200-day ($809.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($872.19), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月9日上涨 10.7%，收于 $596.16，盘中区间 $545.01–616.30。股价收于下行的 5 日均线（$590.3）上方，但仍低于下行的 10 日（$717.6）、30 日（$871.6）和 100 日均线（$851.2），以及上行的 200 日均线（$809.0）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$872.19），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The rally broke the $548–559 resistance ($550, Mar 6 low, Nov 6 high), now support, and reclaimed the $594.8 Jul 29 low. Resistance is $596.8–602.3 (Nov 5 high, Jul 28 low), then $616.3–626.8 (Nov 9 high, Nov 4 close) and $680–684 (Nov 2–3 closes). Support is $590–595, then $545–559 and $518–528. A close above $602.3 would target $616–627; below $590, $559.

s.en: Nov 6 high $559; $550 round number; Mar 6 low $548.2; Nov 9 low $545.0
